The amusement park was closed after 9pm.
Between what times could William have gone to the amusement park?

Options:
(A) 9am to 4pm
(B) 5am to 9am
(C) 4pm to 7pm
(D) 7pm to 9pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- William was seen at the Statue of Liberty between 5am and 9am, so he could not have gone to the amusement park during this time.
- William was seen at the library between 4pm and 7pm, so he could not have gone to the amusement park during this time.
- William was seen at the Leaning Tower of Pisa between 7pm and 9pm, so he could not have gone to the amusement park during this time.

Answer: (A)
